name: Yolvex Frame 41 Original
description: This listing is a barophilic pressure vat listed with vessel volume 599 litres, working temperature 2 degrees Celsius, batch cycle 108 days. Its remaining stated figures are simultaneous batches 10 batches, unit price set after acceptance, atmosphere control microaerobic. Every one of them is quoted from the same six axes the other listings in this category are described on.

reviews.title: Microaerobic was the requirement; this listing meets it
reviews.text: This listing is our third barophilic pressure vat and the first one specified properly. Its atmosphere control is microaerobic, and for this listing that is the whole point. We never looked at the other axes once microaerobic checked out.
